title: Molecular gas and dark neutral medium in the outskirts of Chamaeleon
question: Can molecular gas, traced by HCO+ absorption, be detected in the outskirts of Chamaeleon where DNM was inferred but CO emission was not detected, and does it account for the DNM?

evidence.quote: Specific values of N(DNM) along the present sightlines were extracted from that work for the present use
The 6 ′ resolution dust-emission maps scaled to optical reddening E B−V by Schlegel et al. (1998) are cited in Tables 1 and 2.

what.value: N(HI) associated with Chamaeleon from pseudo-Voigt decomposition of GASS III

evidence.quote: These were derived following the methodology described by Planck Collaboration et al. (2015) and Remy et al. (2018).

external_data.citation: Planck Collaboration et al. (2015); Remy et al. (2018)

recipe.method: Extract spectra at the peak continuum pixel from continuum-subtracted pipeline cubes and divide by continuum flux in that spectral window
Integrate optical depth; N(HCO+)=1.10e12 W; N(H2)=N(HCO+)/3e-9
Optically thin N(HI)=1.823e18 ∫T_B dv from GASS III; Chamaeleon part from pseudo-Voigt decomposition within the Chamaeleon velocity range

recipe.goal: Compare H2, DNM, HI and CO; group sightlines
recipe.method: Group sightlines by N(DNM) (8 vs 5), compute group means, compare N(H) from CO vs HCO+, predict W_CO with X_CO=2e20
assumptions: X_CO = 2e20 H2 cm-2 (K km/s)-1; W_CO=0 except J1723

answer_key.quantity: molecular fraction of H nuclei, high/low/all

evidence.quote: gives N(H 2 )/W CO = 2.3 × 10 20 H 2 cm −2 (Kkm s −1 ) −1

answer_key.quantity: mean E(B-V), high vs low DNM

not_stated_but_needed: Imaging parameters (weighting, cell, deconvolver) of the pipeline products
Spectral window setup and line-free channels used for continuum
Integration velocity ranges for tau integrals
How optical depth was computed (saturation, noise handling)
score_reason: Public data and simple formulae with numeric tables, but processing and integration details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple recipe from pipeline cubes, and numeric table results.
